breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the contribution of the average normal stress to the in-plane shear state; the maximum in-plane shear depends on both σ_avg and τ_avg.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses τ_max = sqrt((σ_avg/2)^2 + τ_avg^2), which includes both the normal stress contribution (σ_avg/2) and the shear stress contribution (τ_avg). This matches the ground truth formula and resolves the inconsistency where the incomplete prompt incorrectly suggested using only the transverse shear stress alone for the maximum in-plane shear. The numerical computation confirms both contributions are included: τ_max = sqrt(8.333^2 + 1.667^2) = 8.498 MPa.
